title: In this QA worktree the meaning-search model is a 134-byte git-lfs pointer, so meaning search never works here, and data/lancedb comes and goes
what_happens: The file in this worktree is 134 bytes: an unfetched git-lfs pointer that names a size of 278647662 bytes. The main checkout has the real file, 278,647,662 bytes (checked by size only). Every load fails with "Load model from ...model_quantized.onnx failed:Protobuf parsing failed.". What that does depends on the shared folder data/lancedb, which every server of this worktree uses. It held incidents.lance and news.lance at first, and was emptied at 21:59:59 by something other than this job; a code comment in tests/qa/pass4/decision-matrix.test.ts says an earlier run of that test could write an index of fake vectors there. State 1, an index on disk: the log repeats "[assistant] search index sync failed: ...", the status reply gives search.ready false and search.error null, and questions that reach the search tool end in an error (audit-ui_honesty-13). State 2, no index: the log repeats "[assistant] embedding index: ...", the status reply gives search.ready false with that error, and the search tool answers by keywords (audit-ui_honesty-14). This is the environment, not the product, but it matters to this QA run: a result from this worktree that touches search was taken with meaning search off, and which state applied depends on when it ran. Servers on ports 3120, 3121 and 3131 logged the same Protobuf error. That is also why ui_honesty-embedding-error.txt (state 1) differs from this finding's first wording (state 2): both were true.
what_should_happen: Before more runs, fetch the file with git lfs pull in the worktree, or add .cache to the junctions in tests/qa/pass4/worktree-setup.mjs. Then re-check results that depend on search. Give the runs one known state for data/lancedb: either no index, or one real index that nothing overwrites.
repro: ls -la .cache/models/Xenova/multilingual-e5-base/onnx/model_quantized.onnx; ls -la data/lancedb; npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/audit-ui_honesty.test.ts
evidence: tests named audit-ui_honesty-11; docs/qa/pass4/evidence/bug-audit/ui_honesty-search-failure-log.txt, ui_honesty-embedding-error.txt; data/aws-cache/qa/run/srv-3120.log, srv-3121.log, srv-3131.log
root_cause_guess: tests/qa/pass4/worktree-setup.mjs (does not link or fetch .cache); .cache not fetched when this worktree was made; data/lancedb shared by all servers (src/lib/assistant/lance.ts:21)

title: When the meaning-search model cannot load and an index exists, any question that reaches search ends in "Something went wrong", not the keyword answer the code promises
what_happens: With an index in data/lancedb and a model file that fails to load, the real chat route returned HTTP 200 with an SSE error event and no answer: "Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.". This happened for "How many feeds are live?" (5 of 5 times, over two servers, on both --frozen and --frozen --ticking), "Tell me about the fallen tree near Adyar", "Any reports about a sinkhole?" and Tamil "பள்ளம் பற்றிய புகார் உள்ளதா?". Trying again does not help. The server log has "assistant chat failed <id> Error: Load model from ... failed:Protobuf parsing failed.". Tanglish wordings in the same run took other routes and were answered, so this was seen only in English and Tamil. The trigger here is this worktree's bad model file, but any model load that fails rather than being slow is the same case, for example a failed first download. Not tested: the same failure with a model answering, since none is allowed in this phase. The index case could not be repeated after the folder was emptied, because every server here shares it, so the real-run record is the saved log and the deterministic test fakes the failure at the boundary.
what_should_happen: A model that cannot load is treated like a model still loading: hybridSearch returns null and the search tool answers by keywords, with its caveat "the meaning search is not available right now". Ready patch: in src/lib/assistant/lance.ts:237 replace the rethrow with: if (e instanceof ModelNotReady) return null; console.warn(`[assistant] meaning search off: ${(e as Error).message}`); return null;. The same in src/lib/assistant/embed.ts:282 for semanticSearch. Do not retry a new worker on each question: keep the failure for a minute before trying again.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/audit-ui_honesty.test.ts, test named audit-ui_honesty-13 and its control (fake LanceDB table and fake embed at the boundary; no model). The real run: the saved log and answers below.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/assistant/lance.ts:236-239 (only ModelNotReady falls back); src/lib/assistant/embed.ts:120,281-284; src/lib/assistant/tools.ts:651-652 (no catch around hybridSearch); the error reaches src/app/api/collector/assistant/chat/route.ts:76
class: resilience: a fallback that covers only one kind of failure

title: With no search index, Ask District IQ says no incidents or news match a subject the store has reports about
what_happens: On the real chat route with no index on disk: "Any reports about a sinkhole?" gets "No incidents or news reports match that in the last 90 days". The same server answers "Any sinkhole?" with "5 matching incidents in the last 90 days", and the pinned store holds 5 incidents and 51 news documents with sinkhole in the title or text, all in the last 90 days. "Any reports about a fallen tree?" and "Any fallen tree?" also get no match, with 19 such news documents. Tamil "பள்ளம் பற்றிய புகார் உள்ளதா?" gets "இதற்குப் பொருந்தும் சம்பவங்களோ செய்திகளோ இல்லை". Two causes: the fallback requires every word of the question, including "report" and the Tamil asking words, and it never searches the news at all, though the sentence says news reports do not match. The card's caveat does say "Searched the incident records for the words \"report\", \"sinkhole\"...; the meaning search is not available right now.", in smaller print under a headline that says otherwise. P0 by the rules' wording (a wrong number: none, where the store has them). Limits: this path runs only when meaning search is unavailable, which here is because of audit-ui_honesty-11. By the code it also runs with no index built (the main checkout has no data/lancedb folder, checked by listing only) and while a model is still starting (over 1.5 s, lance.ts:236), but neither was run with a real model in this phase. A model was not tested. Tanglish "sinkhole report irukka?" took another route ("Incidents matching: 625"), and that figure was not judged.
what_should_happen: Asked about something the store has, the answer finds it; and the sentence claims only what was searched. Ready patch: in src/lib/assistant/tools.ts:58 add "report", "reports", "complaint", "complaints", "news", "பற்றிய", "புகார்", "செய்தி", "உள்ளதா" to NOT_SUBJECT. In tools.ts:655-664 search the news as well (title or body LIKE each word in documents), or set data.newsSearched false. In src/lib/assistant/cards.ts:194, when news was not searched, say "No incident titles or places match those words" and not "No incidents or news reports match that". In keywordIncidents (tools.ts:102), when all words find nothing, try again with the rarest word alone before saying none.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/audit-ui_honesty.test.ts, tests named audit-ui_honesty-14 (the tool on the real pinned data, a fake LanceDB with no tables, no model). By hand on a server with no data/lancedb index: ask the two questions above in Ask District IQ.
